primary_sources.source: Teacher-provided photographed Chapter 11, 双模态冲压燃烧室一维数值模拟
frozen_relations: single-component calorically-perfect limit: cp = gamma/(gamma-1) * R_u/W and h = cp*T
single-component ideal-gas law: p = rho * R_u/W * T
species cp polynomial: cp_s = R_u/W_s * (a1 + a2*T + a3*T^2 + a4*T^3 + a5*T^4)
species enthalpy polynomial: h_s = R_u/W_s * (a1*T + a2*T^2/2 + a3*T^3/3 + a4*T^4/4 + a5*T^5/5 + a6)
Dalton ideal-mixture state law: p = rho*T*sum_s(Y_s*R_u/W_s)
primary_sources.energy_note: The photographed text states that the fitted absolute enthalpy contains sensible enthalpy plus the zero-point/chemical-energy contribution, so reaction heat associated with composition change is already represented in the enthalpy bookkeeping.

primary_sources.source: 曹瑞峰, 超燃冲压发动机燃烧模态转换及其控制方法研究
frozen_relations: species enthalpy polynomial equivalent to the teacher Chapter 11 form

implemented: mixture molecular weight from mass fractions
mixture R(Y), cp(T,Y), cv(T,Y), gamma(T,Y), h(T,Y), e(T,Y)
bounded inversion from e to T for fixed composition
not_implemented_yet: complete source-frozen CHEMKIN/NASA coefficient database for all required species
piecewise low/high-temperature polynomial selection where a species source requires it

coefficient_policy.rule: Do not invent or silently copy thermochemical coefficients. Each production species coefficient set must record source, temperature interval, molecular weight, coefficient convention, and any interval switch temperature before solver integration.
coefficient_policy.note: Additional products/intermediates may be required by the final Cao/teacher closure; the list above is not promoted as a complete chemistry mechanism.
